title: April 1966 Playboy Magazine - First + Last Pages Aren’t Connected - See Pics
descriptionText:
The product is a vintage April 1966 issue of Playboy Magazine, featuring content relevant to men's interests such as art and pop culture. The magazine is in English and published by Playboy, known for its illustrated features and monthly publication frequency. Despite the first and last pages being disconnected, as shown in the pictures, this issue offers a glimpse into the cultural and artistic topics that were popular in the 1960s, making it a desirable item for collectors and enthusiasts of retro magazines.

The centerfold is in great condition.
